decisions.reason: GA4 remains the only Google Analytics standard, so the plugin serves ongoing shop-client demand, costs little to maintain, and complements the firm's analytics services.
Relaunch SEO support is tied directly to the firm's core relaunch projects, has its own page, and costs little to offer, so its option value is clearly worth keeping.
The SEO workshops launched only in 2024, so their prospects are still uncertain, and running them on demand with existing SEO specialists keeps the option cheap to hold until demand becomes clearer.
